# Warden

> Free, open-source software that checks connected AI requests against administrator-defined rules. Policy analysis runs on the gateway’s host. Allowed requests continue to the configured AI provider.

## Start here

- [Documentation](https://warden-theta.vercel.app/docs): connections, rule activation, privacy and deployment.
- [Walkthrough](https://warden-theta.vercel.app/how-it-works): interactive policy flow. The page runs locally in the browser; it does not activate real rules.
- [Source and setup](https://github.com/Wardenlabs/warden): source installation and contributor instructions.
- [Downloads](https://github.com/Wardenlabs/warden/releases/latest): current release assets for macOS and Windows; Linux can run from source.
- [License](https://github.com/Wardenlabs/warden/blob/main/LICENSE): Apache-2.0.

## Coverage

Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode use prompt hooks. Clients with a custom OpenAI-compatible base URL can use the gateway proxy. Warden checks requests sent through these connections, not all traffic on a device. Host deadlines and attachment support affect coverage. Hooks fail open when the gateway cannot answer unless they have learned WARDEN_FAIL_CLOSED=1.

Rule writing is separate from request evaluation. A remote rule writer or signed-in CLI may receive administrator instructions and directory context. A person reviews and activates drafts. Request decisions allow, block or hold for review.

Reported session usage can hold the next request at a configured ceiling. It does not stop an already-running response or independently verify provider billing. Daily request quotas are a separate control.

## Data and evidence

The audit chain stores prompt hashes and decision metadata. Masked prompt text uses a separate store with seven-day retention by default; WARDEN_PROMPT_RETENTION_DAYS=0 disables it. Supported documents are extracted locally; incomplete extraction holds the request.

- [Security](https://github.com/Wardenlabs/warden/blob/main/SECURITY.md): access, retention, compiler data and deployment requirements.
- [Connections](https://github.com/Wardenlabs/warden/blob/main/integrations/README.md): supported integrations and configuration.
- [Hook verification](https://github.com/Wardenlabs/warden/blob/main/docs/HOOK-VERIFICATION.md): tested client behavior and coverage limits.
- [Model management](https://github.com/Wardenlabs/warden/blob/main/docs/MODEL-MANAGEMENT.md): available request models and rule writers.
- [Documents](https://github.com/Wardenlabs/warden/blob/main/docs/DOCUMENTS.md): extraction and attachment handling.
- [Measurements](https://github.com/Wardenlabs/warden/blob/main/docs/MEASUREMENTS.md): datasets, methods and limits of accuracy claims.
